title: Date Everything!
synopsis: Sassy Chap Games’ dating sim where every household object is dateable — retained as Team17’s Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Date Everything! is the first game from Sassy Chap Games, the studio founded by voice actors Ray Chase, Robbie Daymond, and Max Mittelman. Replaced at work by AI, the player receives a pair of Dateviators that turn the objects of the house into a hundred fully voiced dateable characters.

Team17 released it digitally on June 17, 2025, across platforms; the Nintendo Switch physical edition followed on August 28, 2025.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Team17’s retail edition of Date Everything! on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released digitally on June 17, 2025 on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. The Switch physical edition (HAC-P-BHQ3B) released August 28, 2025.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Team17, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
